title: Notch Improvement | Clo 2025.1 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update to notches and seam allowance in CLO 2025.1 allows you to customize default notch length and shape, and place them more accurately at seam allowance corners

Check out other new features here:https://clo3d.com/en/clo/features

markdown_content: ## Notch Improvement and Seam Allowance Updates in CLO 2025.1 This section covers the latest user interface improvements and functional enhancements related to Notches and Seam Allowance in CLO 2025.1. Key topics include Seam Allowance addition, new dropdown UI features, notch display options, and advanced notch customization controls. --- ### Seam Allowance Addition and Dropdown UI Enhancements Seam Allowance can be added easily by clicking directly on a line, a feature that remains unchanged and straightforward. The new update introduces an improved dropdown menu for Seam Allowance options, which enhances usability: - The dropdown displays all available Seam Allowance options quickly. - Hovering over options reveals descriptions, helping users understand each choice without extra clicks or scrolling. - Users can select corner options directly from the dropdown. This UI refinement streamlines the workflow, making Seam Allowance adjustments faster and more intuitive. --- ### Notch Display Settings in User Preferences CLO 2025.1 introduces configurable notch display settings under **User Settings > 2D > Notch**: - **Length Fixed to Screen**: When enabled, notch size adjusts dynamically based on the zoom level—appearing larger when zoomed out and smaller when zoomed in. This maintains visual consistency during pattern navigation. - **Actual Length**: Users can specify a fixed physical length for notches regardless of zoom, allowing precise control over notch size. - **Default Notch Type**: Choose the default notch shape, such as V, T, or I, to standardize notch appearance across the project. Example: Setting the default notch type to "I" with a fixed length of 3.5 units will apply these settings automatically to new notches. --- ### Advanced Notch Customization Controls Significant enhancements have been made to notch placement and configuration, based on user feedback, to support more precise production needs: - **Notch Selection and Direction**: When a notch is selected, detailed controls appear including: - Angle options: *perpendicular*, *custom*, or *segment-based*. - Length input for exact measurement. - Directional assignment options: *point center*, *segment 1*, *segment 2*, or *point center* again. - **Placement Options**: - *Center*: Place notch at the exact center of the segment. - *Seam line extend*: Extend placement along the seam line. - *Point perpendicular*: Place notch perpendicular to a reference point. - *Seam allowance perpendicular*: Position notch relative to the seam allowance line. - **Flip Functionality**: Allows flipping the notch direction for added flexibility. - **Notch Type Switching**: Users can change the notch type dynamically within the customization panel (e.g., switching from I to V or T shapes). These controls enable precise alignment and positioning of notches, critical for production accuracy and pattern clarity. --- ### Summary CLO 2025.1 enhances pattern making by introducing: - Faster and more intuitive Seam Allowance addition with an improved dropdown UI. - Flexible notch display settings allowing either screen-relative sizing or fixed physical sizes. - Comprehensive notch customization, including angle, length, direction, placement, flipping, and shape options. These updates provide users with more control and clarity when working with notches and seam allowances, improving both design flexibility and production readiness.
